tables.name: audit_log
tables.comment: Append-only history of create/update/delete/approve/reject/cancel actions. The application role cannot delete rows or rewrite history.

columns.name: actor_deleted
columns.comment: True once the acting account has been purged and its entries redacted.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.comment: Who acted. Becomes NULL if the account is purged; actor_deleted then marks it.

columns.name: after
columns.comment: Snapshot after the change. The GDPR purge may redact personal fields here.

columns.name: before
columns.comment: Snapshot before the change. The GDPR purge may redact personal fields here.

indexes.name: audit_log_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_log_pkey ON public.audit_log USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_audit_log_actor
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_actor ON public.audit_log USING btree (actor_id) WHERE (actor_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_audit_log_created_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_created_at ON public.audit_log USING btree (created_at)

indexes.name: idx_audit_log_entity
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_entity ON public.audit_log USING btree (entity_type, entity_id)

tables.name: calendar
tables.comment: Calendar entry generated with a session; a deliberate copy of the session dates so the calendar can be edited independently.

indexes.name: calendar_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX calendar_pkey ON public.calendar USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_calendar_session
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_calendar_session ON public.calendar USING btree (session_id)

tables.name: clients
tables.comment: Client companies that training sessions are delivered to. Soft-deleted via deleted_at.

columns.name: country
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in upper case; used to validate the phone number.

indexes.name: clients_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clients_pkey ON public.clients USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_clients_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_clients_active ON public.clients USING btree (id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_clients_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_clients_created_by ON public.clients USING btree (created_by) WHERE (created_by IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: conversation_participants
tables.comment: Membership, per-user read/delivered markers and hide/mute state for a conversation.

columns.name: hidden_at
columns.comment: Set when the user hides the conversation from their list; a new message can bring it back.

columns.name: last_delivered_message_id
columns.comment: Delivery marker; must reference a message of the same conversation.

columns.name: last_read_message_id
columns.comment: Read marker; must reference a message of the same conversation.

columns.name: muted_at
columns.comment: Set when the user mutes notifications for the conversation.

indexes.name: conversation_participants_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_participants_pkey ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (conversation_id, user_id)

indexes.name: idx_conversation_participants_last_delivered
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_conversation_participants_last_delivered ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (last_delivered_message_id) WHERE (last_delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_conversation_participants_last_read
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_conversation_participants_last_read ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (last_read_message_id) WHERE (last_read_message_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_conversation_participants_user
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_conversation_participants_user ON public.conversation_participants USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: conversations
tables.comment: A direct (two-person) or group conversation in the messaging module.

indexes.name: conversations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversations_pkey ON public.conversations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_conversations_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_created_by ON public.conversations USING btree (created_by)

tables.name: feature_announcement_ratings
tables.comment: One 1-5 star rating per user per announcement.

indexes.name: feature_announcement_ratings_announcement_id_user_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_announcement_ratings_announcement_id_user_id_key ON public.feature_announcement_ratings USING btree (announcement_id, user_id)

indexes.name: feature_announcement_ratings_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_announcement_ratings_pkey ON public.feature_announcement_ratings USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_feature_announcement_ratings_announcement
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feature_announcement_ratings_announcement ON public.feature_announcement_ratings USING btree (announcement_id)

indexes.name: idx_feature_announcement_ratings_user
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feature_announcement_ratings_user ON public.feature_announcement_ratings USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: feature_announcement_target_roles
tables.comment: Which roles an announcement targets (junction table; replaces the JSON list, giving first normal form and foreign-key integrity).

indexes.name: feature_announcement_target_roles_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_announcement_target_roles_pkey ON public.feature_announcement_target_roles USING btree (announcement_id, role_id)

indexes.name: idx_announcement_target_roles_role
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_announcement_target_roles_role ON public.feature_announcement_target_roles USING btree (role_id)

tables.name: feature_announcements
tables.comment: Product announcements written by the Developer role and shown to targeted roles until rated.

columns.name: target_roles
columns.comment: DEPRECATED write-through copy of the targeted role names. The relational source is feature_announcement_target_roles, kept in sync by a trigger. To be dropped in a later, explicitly approved migration.

indexes.name: feature_announcements_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_announcements_pkey ON public.feature_announcements USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_feature_announcements_created_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feature_announcements_created_at ON public.feature_announcements USING btree (created_at)

indexes.name: idx_feature_announcements_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feature_announcements_created_by ON public.feature_announcements USING btree (created_by) WHERE (created_by IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: trg_sync_announcement_target_roles
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_announcement_target_roles AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF target_roles ON public.feature_announcements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_announcement_target_roles()

tables.name: feedback_reports
tables.comment: Bug reports and enhancement requests submitted by users; read by the Developer role.

indexes.name: feedback_reports_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feedback_reports_pkey ON public.feedback_reports USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_feedback_reports_created_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_reports_created_at ON public.feedback_reports USING btree (created_at)

indexes.name: idx_feedback_reports_submitted_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_reports_submitted_by ON public.feedback_reports USING btree (submitted_by)

tables.name: instructor_skills
tables.comment: Which trainings an instructor can teach (many-to-many), with an optional certificate and its expiry.

columns.name: expiry_reminder_sent_at
columns.comment: Set once the one-time certificate-expiry reminder has been emailed.

indexes.name: idx_instructor_skills_training
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_instructor_skills_training ON public.instructor_skills USING btree (training_id)

indexes.name: instructor_skills_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instructor_skills_pkey ON public.instructor_skills USING btree (instructor_id, training_id)

tables.name: instructors
tables.comment: Instructor profile, one per instructor user (user_id is unique).

indexes.name: instructors_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instructors_pkey ON public.instructors USING btree (id)

indexes.name: instructors_user_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instructors_user_id_key ON public.instructors USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: message_deletions
tables.comment: Per-user "delete for me" markers; the message stays visible to everyone else.

indexes.name: idx_message_deletions_user
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_message_deletions_user ON public.message_deletions USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: message_deletions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX message_deletions_pkey ON public.message_deletions USING btree (message_id, user_id)

tables.name: messages
tables.comment: Chat messages: text, image, voice or file. Attachments live on disk; only their key and metadata are stored here. Soft-deleted via deleted_at.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Set when deleted for everyone; content is then no longer shown.

columns.name: reply_to_message_id
columns.comment: The message being replied to; must be in the same conversation.

checks.name: ck_messages_attachment_non_negative
checks.definition: CHECK ((((attachment_size_bytes IS NULL) OR (attachment_size_bytes >= 0)) AND ((attachment_duration_seconds IS NULL) OR (attachment_duration_seconds >= 0))))

checks.name: ck_messages_content_shape
checks.definition: CHECK (((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) OR ((type = 'text'::message_type) AND (body IS NOT NULL) AND (attachment_key IS NULL)) OR ((type <> 'text'::message_type) AND (attachment_key IS NOT NULL))))

indexes.name: idx_messages_conversation_id_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_conversation_id_id ON public.messages USING btree (conversation_id, id)

indexes.name: idx_messages_reply_to
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_reply_to ON public.messages USING btree (reply_to_message_id) WHERE (reply_to_message_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_messages_sender
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_sender ON public.messages USING btree (sender_id)

indexes.name: messages_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_pkey ON public.messages USING btree (id)

indexes.name: uq_messages_id_conversation
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_messages_id_conversation ON public.messages USING btree (id, conversation_id)

tables.name: providers
tables.comment: Training providers (e.g. Red Hat). Soft-deleted via deleted_at; names are unique among active providers.

indexes.name: idx_providers_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_providers_active ON public.providers USING btree (id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_providers_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_providers_created_by ON public.providers USING btree (created_by) WHERE (created_by IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_providers_name_active
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_providers_name_active ON public.providers USING btree (name) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: providers_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_pkey ON public.providers USING btree (id)

tables.name: push_subscriptions
tables.comment: Web-push endpoints per user and device (unique per user and endpoint). Endpoints must be https.

indexes.name: idx_push_subscriptions_endpoint
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_push_subscriptions_endpoint ON public.push_subscriptions USING btree (endpoint)

indexes.name: idx_push_subscriptions_user
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_push_subscriptions_user ON public.push_subscriptions USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: push_subscriptions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX push_subscriptions_pkey ON public.push_subscriptions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: push_subscriptions_user_id_endpoint_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX push_subscriptions_user_id_endpoint_key ON public.push_subscriptions USING btree (user_id, endpoint)

tables.name: reports
tables.comment: Generated report per session (session_id unique) with the averaged scores frozen at generation time.

indexes.name: reports_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_pkey ON public.reports USING btree (id)

indexes.name: reports_session_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_session_id_key ON public.reports USING btree (session_id)

tables.name: roles
tables.comment: Fixed set of application roles (Sales, Manager, Instructor, SuperAdmin, Developer). Reference data seeded by the baseline migration.

indexes.name: roles_name_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_name_key ON public.roles USING btree (name)

indexes.name: roles_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_pkey ON public.roles USING btree (id)

tables.name: session_attendees
tables.comment: People registered on a session. Identity is the name plus an optional email; an email may appear once per session (case-insensitive).

columns.name: attendance_status
columns.comment: pending, present or absent, marked by the instructor.

columns.name: survey_submitted
columns.comment: Denormalised flag kept in step with the existence of a survey row for this attendee.

indexes.name: idx_attendees_email
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_attendees_email ON public.session_attendees USING btree (lower((email)::text))

indexes.name: idx_attendees_session
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_attendees_session ON public.session_attendees USING btree (session_id)

indexes.name: session_attendees_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_attendees_pkey ON public.session_attendees USING btree (id)

indexes.name: session_attendees_session_email_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_attendees_session_email_key ON public.session_attendees USING btree (session_id, lower((email)::text)) WHERE ((email IS NOT NULL) AND ((email)::text <> ''::text))

indexes.name: uq_session_attendees_id_session
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_session_attendees_id_session ON public.session_attendees USING btree (id, session_id)

tables.name: session_notes
tables.comment: Free-text notes an assigned instructor leaves on a session. Only the author may edit or delete.

indexes.name: idx_session_notes_instructor
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_session_notes_instructor ON public.session_notes USING btree (instructor_id)

indexes.name: idx_session_notes_session_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_session_notes_session_id ON public.session_notes USING btree (session_id)

indexes.name: session_notes_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_notes_pkey ON public.session_notes USING btree (id)

tables.name: surveys
tables.comment: One survey answer per attendee (attendee_id unique when present). Scores: instructor 0-5, NPS 0-10.

columns.name: instructor_id
columns.comment: Snapshot of the instructor at submission time; deliberately not derived from the session, which may be reassigned later.

indexes.name: idx_surveys_instructor
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_surveys_instructor ON public.surveys USING btree (instructor_id) WHERE (instructor_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_surveys_session
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_surveys_session ON public.surveys USING btree (session_id)

indexes.name: surveys_attendee_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX surveys_attendee_id_key ON public.surveys USING btree (attendee_id) WHERE (attendee_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: surveys_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX surveys_pkey ON public.surveys USING btree (id)

tables.name: training_sessions
tables.comment: A scheduled delivery of one training for one client, optionally assigned to one instructor. The central table of the domain.

columns.name: assignment_status
columns.comment: unassigned or accepted in current use. pending and refused are legacy states of a retired accept/refuse flow.

columns.name: include_weekends
columns.comment: Whether the session runs on weekends between start_date and end_date.

columns.name: reminder_1h_sent_at
columns.comment: Set when the 1-hour push reminder was sent, so it is sent once.

columns.name: reminder_24h_sent_at
columns.comment: Set when the 24-hour push reminder was sent, so it is sent once.

indexes.name: idx_sessions_client
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_client ON public.training_sessions USING btree (client_id)

indexes.name: idx_sessions_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_created_by ON public.training_sessions USING btree (created_by) WHERE (created_by IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_sessions_instructor
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_instructor ON public.training_sessions USING btree (instructor_id)

indexes.name: idx_sessions_start_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_start_date ON public.training_sessions USING btree (start_date)

indexes.name: idx_sessions_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_status ON public.training_sessions USING btree (session_status)

indexes.name: idx_sessions_training
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_training ON public.training_sessions USING btree (training_id)

indexes.name: training_sessions_instructor_start_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX training_sessions_instructor_start_key ON public.training_sessions USING btree (instructor_id, start_date) WHERE ((instructor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (session_status <> 'cancelled'::session_status))

indexes.name: training_sessions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX training_sessions_pkey ON public.training_sessions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: training_sessions_training_start_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX training_sessions_training_start_key ON public.training_sessions USING btree (training_id, start_date) WHERE (session_status <> 'cancelled'::session_status)

tables.name: trainings
tables.comment: Catalog of trainings offered, each belonging to one provider. Soft-deleted via deleted_at.

columns.name: duration
columns.comment: Length in duration_unit. May be 0. Some legacy rows have a duration without a unit.

checks.name: ck_trainings_unit_requires_duration
checks.definition: CHECK (((duration_unit IS NULL) OR (duration IS NOT NULL)))

indexes.name: idx_trainings_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_trainings_active ON public.trainings USING btree (id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_trainings_created_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_trainings_created_by ON public.trainings USING btree (created_by) WHERE (created_by IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_trainings_provider
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_trainings_provider ON public.trainings USING btree (provider_id)

indexes.name: trainings_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trainings_pkey ON public.trainings USING btree (id)

tables.name: users
tables.comment: Every account. Self-signup creates status pending; a Manager approves or rejects. Emails are unique ignoring letter case.

columns.name: approved_by
columns.comment: The approving Manager. Set to NULL if that account is later purged.

columns.name: has_seen_tour
columns.comment: Whether the guided-tour dashboard has already auto-launched for this user.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: pending (awaiting approval), approved, rejected, or deactivated (soft-disabled by a SuperAdmin).

indexes.name: idx_users_approved_by
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_users_approved_by ON public.users USING btree (approved_by) WHERE (approved_by IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: users_email_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key ON public.users USING btree (email)

indexes.name: users_email_lower_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_lower_key ON public.users USING btree (lower((email)::text))

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
